reference.title: Troubleshooting the ESP32 Temperature Monitoring System

section.title: No sensor readings
section.p: Verify that the DHT sensor is connected correctly to the ESP32. Check the power, ground, and data pin connections.

section.title: Incorrect temperature or humidity values
section.p: Ensure that the correct DHT sensor type is selected in the program and confirm that the sensor connections are secure.

section.title: ESP32 cannot connect to Wi-Fi
section.p: Verify the SSID and password in the Wi-Fi configuration section. Restart the ESP32 after confirming the network credentials.

section.title: Program upload fails
section.p: Confirm that the correct ESP32 board and communication port are selected in the Arduino IDE. Reconnect the USB cable and retry the upload.
